To retrieve the names of stores that have a higher count of products than the average, you can use the following SQL query:

```sql
SELECT s.store_name
FROM stores s
JOIN products p ON s.store_id = p.store_id
GROUP BY s.store_name
HAVING COUNT(p.product_id) > (
    SELECT AVG(product_count)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count
        FROM stores s
        JOIN products p ON s.store_id = p.store_id
        GROUP BY s.store_id
    ) avg_counts
);
```

This query counts the number of products in each store, calculates the average product count across all stores, and then retrieves the names of stores that exceed this average.
